info.title: API.SH: Harvey Norman
info.description: The Harvey Norman API from API.SH: public Harvey Norman data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Harvey Norman's categories with number, name, path, link and whether they are active, optionally matching words; use the number or path with /harveynorman/v1/category. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/harveynorman-categories

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The products of a Harvey Norman category (by its path, link or number), in the same shape as search, with the category's facets, filters, price range, sorts and pages; optional keywords within the category. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/harveynorman-category

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category path (e.g. computers-tablets/computers/laptops), link or number.

parameters.name: in_stock
parameters.description: true: only products the shop can sell now.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc, rating, newest, best_sellers.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search Harvey Norman Australia's catalogue: products with id, SKU, name, link, price in AUD and price band, special-price and clearance flags, rating and review count, barcode, department, image and category numbers; the total, page count and every facet the shop has for the results (product type, brand, price band, specials, screen size, storage, memory, colour and many more) with counts. Filter with `facets[].values[].filter` values (several separated by |), a price range, in-stock only, or a category number; sort by relevance, price, rating, newest or best sellers; up to 100 per page. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/harveynorman-search

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Values from `facets[].values[].filter` (e.g. def_general_brand:Dyson|specials:Clearance); values of one attribute are OR-ed, attributes AND-ed.

parameters.name: in_stock
parameters.description: true: only products the shop can sell now.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc, rating, newest, best_sellers.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Harvey Norman store: code, name, type, address, coordinates, phone numbers when listed, weekly opening hours, click-and-collect hours, special hours, description, categories and photos.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/harveynorman-store

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Store slug (e.g. albany-warehouse), its link, or the store code.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Harvey Norman's Australian stores and warehouses: store code, name, link, type, address, coordinates, phone numbers when listed, weekly opening hours and special hours; filter by state, words (name, suburb, postcode) or stores only / warehouses only, or sort by distance from a point. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/harveynorman-stores

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT or NT.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words in the name, address, suburb or postcode.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude to sort by distance (with lon).

parameters.name: warehouses
parameters.description: true: warehouses only; false: other stores only.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Popular Harvey Norman searches that match the start of what was typed, with how many products each finds and its popularity.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/harveynorman-suggest

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
